name: Channel Strategy
description: Detects a project's communication and distribution channels down to the places where an action can happen, scores channels and the concrete actions inside each one, makes every action measurable (UTM, events, store counters) and records it so its impact is measured after its window; decides launch, test, strengthen, reduce, watch or drop and writes the 30 and 90 day plans. Structuring choices and public actions go to the owner as tracker decisions.
